question: Why do some learned people dispute this teaching?
premises: Some learned people do not know the root principle.
They dispute the teaching presented here.
Their effort serves to protect their own mental constructions.
inference: Those who dispute this do so not from insight into the root principle but to defend their own imagined views.
plain_english: But those learned people who do not know the root principle and dispute this are surely engaged only in protecting their own fantasy-kingdom.
